# Public skills used as parser fixtures

These SKILL.md files are unmodified copies of public Agent Skills, kept to verify the client/skills parser (add-skills task 1.1). They are test data only and are never loaded by the product.

- `anthropics/`: 18 skills from https://github.com/anthropics/skills, commit e4bb5d960d87126ff3b3a8af1a104b7db67560ba, each under the Apache License 2.0 in its folder's LICENSE.txt. doc-coauthoring and the template were left out because they carry no licence.
- `superpowers/`: 2 skills from https://github.com/obra/superpowers, commit 22f0b463e7a5e579904dd6211a520321035526f7, under the MIT License in `superpowers/LICENSE`.

Copied on 2026-11-19.
